description.zh:
要修改名称的域名分组ID。<props="china">可通过调用[DescribeDomainGroups ](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomaingroups?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取</props>
<props="intl">可通过调用[DescribeDomainGroups ](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomaingroups?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取</props>
description.en: The ID of the domain name group whose name you want to modify. You can call the [DescribeDomainGroups ](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomaingroups?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d\_0)operation to obtain the ID.

description.zh: 域名分组修改后的新名称。
description.en: The new name of the domain name group.

description.zh:
返回值语言，取值：
- zh：中文
- en：英文

默认：en
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

Default value: en.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns update-domain-group --lang en --group-id 60bb3ef15ace449082cf914ed3ea0000 --group-name NewName --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns UpdateDomainGroup --region cn-hangzhou --GroupName NewName --Lang en --GroupId 60bb3ef15ace449082cf914ed3ea0000
